plugins.name: Keeper Usage Push
plugins.description: Durably buffers CPA usage and uploads it to a central Keeper over HTTPS. Set the upload URL and token from Keeper's Push receiving page in this plugin's settings. / 将 CPA 用量可靠缓存在本地，并通过 HTTPS 推送到中心 Keeper；在插件设置中填写 Keeper「推送接收」页面提供的上传地址和 token 即可。
plugins.author: brooke1220
